patches.name: NewX: Remove ads
patches.description: Filters promoted posts and modules from NewX timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Browse tweet object
patches.description: Adds a debug option to browse the tweet object in NewX post menus.

patches.name: NewX: Open canonical URLs
patches.description: Opens the expanded (canonical) URL directly when clicking links instead of the shortened t.co link.

patches.name: NewX: Custom font
patches.description: Customise font style

patches.name: NewX: Custom sharing domain
patches.description: Allows for using domains like fxtwitter when sharing tweets/posts.

patches.name: NewX: Customize drawer items
patches.description: Lets you hide selected items from the NewX navigation drawer.

patches.name: NewX: Dynamic color
patches.description: Applies the system Material You palette to NewX.

patches.name: NewX: Feature switch overrides
patches.description: Adds searchable, typed NewX feature switch overrides.

patches.name: NewX: Customize inline actions
patches.description: Lets you hide selected actions from NewX post action bars.

patches.name: NewX: Inline download button
patches.description: Adds a Download button below NewX posts and saves images to Pictures/Twitter and videos to Movies/Twitter.

patches.name: NewX: Force highest video/audio quality
patches.description: Forces video playback to always select the highest available video and audio stream quality without adaptive quality downscaling or network bitrate caps.

patches.name: NewX: Customize default media tab
patches.description: Lets you choose the default sub-tab (Photos or Videos) for the NewX profile media tab.

patches.name: NewX: Customize navigation bar items
patches.description: Lets you hide selected items from the NewX bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: NewX: Customize default reply sorting
patches.description: Lets you choose the default reply sorting order for NewX post detail.

patches.name: NewX: Share post as image
patches.description: Adds a rendered-image share action to NewX post menus.

patches.name: NewX: Disable video player scrolling
patches.description: Disables vertical swipes in the NewX video player while keeping playback controls and other gestures available.

patches.name: NewX: Hide premium upsell
patches.description: Hides the premium upsell chip from the NewX home top bar.

patches.name: NewX: Unlock downloads
patches.description: Unlocks media downloads and offline video saving in NewX.

patches.name: NewX: Disable automatic timeline refresh
patches.description: Prevents automatic timeline jumps on startup and foregrounding.

patches.name: NewX: Filter For You by topic
patches.description: Restricts the NewX For You timeline to selected topics.

patches.name: NewX: Hide AI-generated posts
patches.description: Hides selected AI-generated posts from NewX timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Hide Discover more
patches.description: Removes the Discover more module from post-detail timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Hide compose button
patches.description: Removes the compose button from NewX timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Hide new posts pill
patches.description: Hides the new posts pill in NewX timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Hide Spaces bar
patches.description: Hides the Spaces bar above NewX timelines.

patches.name: NewX: Hide who to follow
patches.description: Hides recommended-user sections ("Who to follow") from NewX timelines and profile pages.

patches.name: NewX: Restore timeline position
patches.description: Persists the timeline index and offset, then restores them after the app process restarts.

patches.name: NewX: Show sensitive media
patches.description: Shows sensitive media without requiring confirmation in NewX.

patches.name: NewX: Filter posts by keyword
patches.description: Filters NewX posts using user-defined words and phrases.
